sheets_fetch.change: When Yahoo reference rows are invalid or missing, verify Korean prices against identified Naver history; require full valid reference coverage.

history_refresh.change: Add explicit full-history batch mode covering the configured retention window and every stored date, with committed metadata recovery for missing daily files. Manual refresh default is unchanged.

soxx_recovery.change: Remove verified foreign holiday bars, then reconcile all retained SOXX prices with an isolated provider snapshot; preserve both repair stages and regenerate aggregates.

universe_integrity.change: Correct the exact 2023-07-25 NDX opening price error observed in the read-only GOOGLEFINANCE audit and confirmed against Yahoo and stored prices.

universe_recovery.change: Naver confirms 16 of 17 unverified domestic bars; correct LS ELECTRIC 2024-11-07 and preserve raw share-volume convention and prior audit lineage.

batch_audit.change: Publish the allowlisted ticker, failure code and historical bar date as brace-free JSON arrays in a v2 GitHub check annotation so secret masking does not hide them.

batch_schedule.change: Add a Saturday 09:20 Korea-time full-history run after the UTC date rollover so stocker can evaluate the US Friday daily bar on Saturday.

batch_recovery.change: After the first failed scheduled main run, run the same full-history collection, validation and publication workflow once from main. Also allow a manual recovery from main.
